_meta.role: Data Labeling Analyst - Speech & Voice AI

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with hands-on machine learning and NLP experience in speech and language models. Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline from scratch (15% WER on Indian-English) and benchmarked LLM evaluation on HellaSwag, GSM8K and ARC. Curated and annotated training datasets and built automated synthetic data generation pipelines, working daily in Python, Linux and command-line tools.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by fine-tuning DONUT (OCR-free document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Evaluated U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19 and ResNet-50 backbones on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Achieved 15% WER on the NPTEL 2020 Indian-English dataset while reducing preprocessing latency via optimized tokenization.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Benchmarked LLM evaluation across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase.
Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and latency using pynvml and psutil.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) and Gemini intent classification (<500ms) into a voice-to-pick pipeline with 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Resolved 11 integration failures through testing and validation; built a data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated synthetic data generation pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation; trained YOLO11n to mAP50~0.85.
